article_content: Casey Kasem's second wife Jean Kasem will handle funeral arrangements after daughter Kerri Kasem released custody of his remains following their legal dispute over end-of-life care. The radio icon died June 14, 2014 at 82 from complications of Parkinson's disease and Lewy Body Dementia. Kerri had temporary medical guardianship until his passing. Jean, named executor per Casey's wishes, arranged final rites after legal coordination. Their estrangement stemmed from contested caregiving decisions including relocating Casey to Washington State and discontinuing nutritional support. Despite adversarial proceedings, both parties cooperated pragmatically on posthumous arrangements. Kasem's enduring legacy includes pioneering the 'American Top 40' radio format and voicing Shaggy in Scooby-Doo across multiple generations.

article_content: Country singer Mindy McCready is under investigation regarding the fatal shooting of her boyfriend David Wilson, following new allegations of marital conflict. Sources claim Wilson had been unfaithful, sparking intense arguments that led him to temporarily leave their Arkansas home. After returning, he reportedly declared intentions to end the relationship permanently before dying from a gunshot wound on January 13. While authorities initially deemed the death self-inflicted, inconsistencies persist. Notably, McCready placed the 911 call despite earlier reports of her absence, with operators hearing male vocalizations in the background. The tragedy occurred shortly after McCready secured sole custody of her son Zander through a Supreme Court ruling, a milestone thought to have stabilized their relationship. Friends described Wilson as unusually cheerful beforehand, deepening the mystery. Police have not named suspects but continue probing irregularities in the case.

article_content: A 6.8-magnitude undersea earthquake struck the Philippines' southern Mindanao region on Nov. 17 at 4:14 p.m., initially reported as 7.2 before PHIVOLCS revised the measurement. No tsunami warning was issued. Casualty reports remain unverified: NDRMMC cites seven possible deaths under review, while local authorities confirm three deaths in General Santos City (collapsed wall victims) and one mall-related fatality. Sarangani Province reports three deaths and 61 injuries including a pregnant woman transferred for care. Over 1,500 households face displacement/damage. Glan's municipal hall is unsafe. Governor Pacquiao confirmed road clearance and utility restoration efforts but urged caution. General Santos City treated 541 patients, offering free medical services. Classes remain suspended. The Ring of Fire's seismic activity caused structural damage including the Old Buayan Bridge closure. Red Cross assisted injured students. Partial power restoration occurred by evening.

article_content: EastEnders actress Linda Henry is set to stand trial over allegations of racially aggravated harassment following a confrontation outside a Jamie Oliver restaurant in London. The 51-year-old, known for portraying Shirley Carter in the long-running BBC soap, pleaded not guilty at Bexley Magistrates' Court. Prosecutors allege she used threatening or abusive language during an incident on September 14 at Jamie's Italian in Greenwich, which they describe as racially motivated. Henry, who denies the claims, has vowed to vigorously defend herself against the charges. Her trial is scheduled for February 11, 2024. The restaurant's manager stated none of their staff were involved in the altercation. While continuing to film EastEnders, Henry joins a list of recent co-stars—including Ricky Norwood and Khali Best—facing suspensions over misconduct allegations, though her case remains unresolved. The BBC has not commented publicly on the matter.

Pihakkuasa mendakwa beliau menggunakan perkataan mengancam atau tidak sopan semasa kejadian pada 14 September di Jamie's Italian, Greenwich, yang disokong motif rasial. Henry, yang menyangkal tuduhan tersebut, menyatakan akan berlawan dengan gigih untuk membersihkan nama beliau. Sidangnya ditetapkan pada 11 Februari 2024. Pengurus restoran menegaskan tidak ada staf terlibat. article_content: Mitt Romney's selection of Paul Ryan as his 2012 vice-presidential running mate unfolded as a meticulously orchestrated operation marked by unprecedented secrecy. Key meetings occurred in secluded settings: Ryan’s critical discussion with Romney took place in a private Massachusetts home after a low-profile arrival arranged by Myers’ son. The timeline shifted due to tragic events when a Wisconsin Sikh temple shooting forced postponement of the original New Hampshire announcement. Ryan’s clandestine departure from his Wisconsin home via wooded paths exemplified the campaign’s evasion tactics, culminating in a swift transition from private citizen to national figure.
